artworks.title: David Garrick in the Role of Richard III
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in an animated stance, wielding a sword with one arm raised above his head. He has a dramatic expression, dark tousled hair, and is dressed in elaborate attire. The background features a rocky landscape, a dramatic sky, figures on horseback in battle, and a distant castle.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying Shields and Without Bevors
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over black chalk and leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored horses with riders engaged in combat. The scene features two riders in medieval armor equipped with helms and pole weapons, resembling halberds. The horses are adorned with caparisons. There is a fallen sleeve in the top right of the drawing. The overall image appears to capture a moment of intense action from the depicted period.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying Shields and Without Bevors
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two knights in armor on horseback engaged in a jousting match. They are dressed in colorful armor typical of medieval knights. Both knights are riding upright towards each other, holding lances. The knight on the right has a more elaborate helmet compared to the one on the left. The lance of the knight on the right is shattered, indicating impact. The background is plain with a parchment-like texture.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying Shields and Without Bevors
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored knights on horseback during a joust. It depicts two horses with riders clad in full armor, including helmets with decorative details. Each knight holds a lance, poised as if they are about to engage in a jousting match. The horses are also adorned in armor, with a colorful caparison draped over them. On the ground, there are lances and a halberd seen in the foreground. There are also disembodied arms and hands illustrated in the composition, adding an abstract element. The style is illustrative, capturing the medieval theme of chivalric tournaments.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying Shields and Without Bevors
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a jousting scene. The image shows two armored knights engaged in combat on horseback. One knight, dressed in green and white armor with a winged helmet, is mounted on a green and white horse and holds a lance. The other knight, in brown and gold armor, has fallen backward from a similar horse, depicting defeat. The scene conveys the drama of medieval jousting tournaments, showcasing elaborate armor and vivid colors typical of the period. The style is reminiscent of historical manuscript illustrations from medieval times.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying Shields and Without Bevors
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over black chalk and leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored horsemen in a jousting scene. The image depicts two knights clad in ornate armor engaging in a joust, each mounted on a horse adorned with intricately patterned caparisons. The knight on the left wields a lance, his helmet adorned with floral elements and a feather crest, while his steed is richly caparisoned in red, green, and white cloth. The knight on the right, also on a decorated horse, is depicted as if recovering from a jousting impact, with pieces of broken lance visible mid-air and on the ground. The drawing captures the dynamic motion and elaborate detail typical of medieval jousting tournaments, with emphasis on the decorative and tactical aspects of the sport.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying Shields and Without Bevors
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two mounted knights in a jousting match. The scene portrays a jousting duel, where two armored knights on horseback are engaged in combat with lances. The knight on the left rides a horse draped in a striped brown and beige fabric, while the knight on the right rides a horse clad in red. Both knights are clad in armor, with detailed helmets, and hold long lances that cross each other in the center of the composition. A small pink flag is seen to the right. The drawing captures the dramatic movement and historical essence of a medieval jousting tournament.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying Shields and Without Bevors
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of two armored knights jousting on horseback. The image shows two knights on their horses, engaging in a jousting competition. Both knights are in full armor with helmets and are holding lances. The horses are depicted galloping. One knight's helmet has a plume. The colors used are green and brown. The composition is framed within a border. The style is reminiscent of a traditional medieval manuscript illustration.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying Shields and Without Bevors
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an image of two armored figures mounted on horses. It depicts two knights in full armor riding decorated horses. The knights carry weapons and shields. The horses are adorned in protective gear and the armor features blue and gold elements with elaborate patterns and plumes on their helmets. Additional elements like a floating glove and helmet are included. The background is plain, focusing on the detailed figures. The style is reminiscent of early Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying Shields and Without Bevors
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This illustration depicts two armored knights on horseback engaged in a joust. Both knights are wearing traditional jousting armor, with their faces covered by helmets. One knight is on a brown horse, while the other is on a multi-colored horse with a red, white, and green caparison. The knights are charging towards each other with lances aimed for impact. The lances are long wooden poles with pointed ends. Above the scene, there are gloves and a piece of fabric depicted. The drawing is in a traditional medieval or Renaissance jousting illustration style.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying Shields and Without Bevors
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of two armored knights on horseback in a jousting match.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War in Reinforced Field Armor
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored knights on horseback engaging in a joust. The image features two knights in blueish-grey armor with adorned helmets participating in a jousting tournament. They are mounted on decorated horses, one black and one brown. Lances are shown between the knights, one broken. The style suggests a historical period setting with attention to detail in armor and barding design. The illustration conveys the energy and motion of a jousting match with clean lines and subtle coloration.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War in Reinforced Field Armor
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fallen armored horse and a knight. The image shows a horse in elaborate armor on the ground, wrapped in intricately detailed fabric with blue and gold designs. The horse's position suggests a dramatic scene. Beside and partly beneath the horse is a blue-armored figure, likely a knight, also on the ground. Broken lances and armor pieces are scattered around the scene, adding to the sense of chaos and movement in the drawing.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War in Reinforced Field Armor
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored knights jousting on horseback. The scene depicts two knights in full armor engaged in a jousting match, each mounted on elaborately adorned horses. The knight on the left is clad in blue armor with decorative plumes on the helmet and a blue drape covering the horse, while the knight on the right wears red, with matching colored gear for the horse. Both knights are wielding lances, positioned as if they are about to connect in the joust. The composition is minimalistic yet carefully detailed, illustrating the movement and confrontation between these mounted figures. The page includes hand-drawn lines framing the scene as well as handwritten numbers at the top.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War in Reinforced Field Armor
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two knights in armor engaged in a joust. The drawing depicts two mounted knights clad in full suits of armor, each wielding a lance aimed at the other. The horses are also adorned in protective coverings. The knights' armor features colorful details and plume-like decorations on their helmets. The scene captures the moment of impact in a joust, as one of the lances is breaking with the fragmented pieces suspended in the air. The background is void of detail, keeping the focus on the action and the detailed depiction of the knights and their steeds. The drawing has a delicate, sketched quality with light shading and emphasis on the intricate design of the armor.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War in Reinforced Field Armor
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored figures on horseback. The image depicts two horses facing each other, each ridden by a knight clad in shiny, metallic armor. The armor has a reflective quality with a light blue tint that accentuates its outline and structure. The horses are draped in caparisons, with one being a brown hue and the other a shade of black and white. Both riders appear to be involved in a medieval joust or similar activity, as evidenced by the broken lances scattered on the ground beneath them. The drawing captures a moment of action, as the positions of the riders seem animated. The figures are outlined in ink and filled with watercolor, highlighting contrasts in both texture and color within the drawing.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War in Reinforced Field Armor
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink with watercolor over leadpoint and black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two knights in armor on horseback engaged in a duel. The scene depicts two armored knights, each riding a horse that is also partially armored. The knights are facing each other in combat, with their swords raised. The knight on the left has a helmet adorned with a crown and possibly an animal figure, while the knight on the right features a helmet with decorative plumes. The horse on the left has a cloth draped over its body, while the horse on the right wears a golden cloth. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures without distraction. The drawing is detailed with an emphasis on the armor and the postures of the knights, creating a sense of movement and action within the piece.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War in Reinforced Field Armor
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor and corrected with white gouache on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored figures on horseback, engaged in or preparing for a joust. The scene depicts two armored figures, each atop a richly adorned horse, facing each other with broken lances. The armor is intricate, with attention to detail on the plumes and horse armor. The horses are depicted with coverings that complement the knights' armor, and the broken lances scattered on the ground emphasize the action or aftermath of the joust. The drawing is done in a style that focuses on line work and light shading.

artworks.title: Italian Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk and leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a knight in a jousting scene. The image shows a mounted knight in full armor riding a horse, both adorned with a green and red patterned cloth. The knight is in a jousting competition, with broken lance pieces in the air. The background features a wooden barrier, depicting part of the jousting arena. The composition captures the action of a medieval tournament, with detail in the knight's armor and horse's coverings.

artworks.title: Italian Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored figures on horseback engaged in a joust. Both knights are clad in ornate armor and mounted on horses as they participate in the match. The scene captures the moment of impact, with splintered lances flying in the air. One knight in silver armor with blue accents is being unseated from his horse, while the other knight in red and silver armor remains mounted. Both horses are draped in colors matching their riders' armors. The focus is on the dynamic action and energy of the joust, with fine details showing the armor's shine and the movement of the horses. The drawing is bordered, and there is some script at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Italian Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: A drawing depicting two individuals in medieval armor in a tournament setting. One figure in green armor with red accents lies defeated on the ground, while the other figure in red armor stands upright holding a broken lance. Both are wearing full plate armor. The setting includes a wooden barrier, and the scene is enclosed within a rectangular border. There are annotations and a signature, “Jacob de Wori.”

artworks.title: Italian Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over leadpoint and black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of two armored knights jousting on horseback. The image shows two knights clad in full armor engaging in a joust, with their lances breaking upon impact. The knight on the left is mounted on a horse adorned with a blue and gold ornamental cloth and helmeted with decorative antlers. The knight on the right wears a red plumed helmet and horse clothing. The scene is set against a simple background with a wooden barrier marking the jousting arena. The painting has a medieval manuscript style, reminiscent of detailed illustrations from that era.

artworks.title: Italian Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a jousting scene. The drawing depicts two armored knights on horseback engaged in a jousting match. They are both clad in ornate armor, one with antler-like adornments on the helmet and the horses are equally elaborately covered with decorative cloth. Wooden lances are clashing, with one lance appearing broken upon impact. The background features a wooden barrier separating the jousting lane, with some notes or annotations visible on the page.

artworks.title: Italian Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk and leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an image of two armored figures on horseback engaged in a jousting match. The scene shows a moment where the figures have collided. The figure on the right wears a red cloak and is on a horse leaping forward, while the figure on the left, in green, is being pushed back. Both figures and horses are adorned with colorful attire and detailed armor. Broken lances and wooden planks suggest the impact. The background features a wooden fence, highlighting the central action. The style is reminiscent of medieval manuscript illustrations or artworks associated with jousting knights and tournaments.
